Container.Name: hebrew-poc
Container.Overview: Hebrew learning app (proof of concept). Type a Hebrew phrase, hear it read aloud by Azure, Google or ElevenLabs side by side, then record yourself and get a word-by-word check from a local Whisper speech model (runs on CPU, no GPU needed).[br][br] Fill in at least one TTS API key below. Generated audio is cached in appdata, so each phrase is only paid for once.[br][br] First start downloads the Hebrew speech model (~1.6 GB) into appdata; the web page shows the progress.[br][br] The microphone only works over HTTPS: on the Unraid host run "tailscale serve --bg 8000" and open https://YOUR-SERVER.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net
Container.Requires: The image is private: install the "hebrew-poc" plugin first (Plugins → Install Plugin, URL in github.com/jdrudolph/unraid-templates); it connects Docker to GitHub. Plus at least one API key: Azure Speech, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech or ElevenLabs.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web page and API.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Audio cache and downloaded speech model (~1.6 GB).

Config.Name: Azure Speech key
Config.Description: portal.azure.com → create a Speech resource (free F0 tier) → Keys and Endpoint.

Config.Name: Azure region
Config.Description: Region of your Speech resource, e.g. westeurope, germanywestcentral.

Config.Name: Google TTS API key
Config.Description: Google Cloud console → enable Cloud Text-to-Speech API → create an API key restricted to it.

Config.Name: Speech model
Config.Description: ivrit-ai = Hebrew-tuned, most accurate (a few seconds per phrase on an N100). small = fast but weak at Hebrew.

Config.Name: Google voice
Config.Description: Leave empty for the default he-IL voice, or e.g. he-IL-Wavenet-A.

Config.Name: ElevenLabs voice ID
Config.Description: Any voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library.
